rv.q: For a generation of post-Johnson politicians, hoodwinking the public has become a reflex reaction. So even if we no longer feel so keenly Animal Farm’s parallels with a mid-20th century Soviet Union, with the Stalin-like Napoleon banishing the Trotsky-like Snowball, we cannot avoid its resonances in a world of fake news and online conspiracy...
Ian Wooldridge’s intensely physical, visceral adaptation of Orwell’s timeless classic
